newsitem.title: INDIA: India to encourage oil refiners into exploration.
newsitem.headline: India to encourage oil refiners into exploration.

text.p: India plans to encourage companies engaged in oil refining and other downstream activities to enter into production and exploration, a government minister said on Tuesday.
Junior Petroleum Minister T. R. Baalu told parliament deputies that this was a part of a strategy being drawn up for oil companies in the coming years.
He said state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) and Oil India Ltd were entering into strategic alliances to operate in India and abroad.
The minister said the government was examining proposals to give additional powers to ONGC and other oil companies to make investment decisions.
Baalu said it was necessary to open up the domestic oil sector to foreign investment to increase exploration activities.
